notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least 2 cards this turn.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
